==Days of the week==
===Numeric system===
Rafsi are based on numeric rafsi. Starts with 1=Monday, or 0=Sunday. Advantages include compatibility with some languages (e.g. Chinese) and ISO numbering. Disadvantages include clashing with numbering in other languages (e.g. Portuguese)
{| class="wikitable"
! English !! Lojban
|-
| Monday || {{jvs|pavdei}}
|-
| Tuesday || {{jvs|reldei}}
|-
| Wednesday || {{jvs|cibdei}}
|-
| Thursday || {{jvs|vondei}}
|-
| Friday || {{jvs|mumdei}}
|-
| Saturday || {{jvs|xavdei}}
|-
| Sunday || {{jvs|zeldei}} / {{jvs|nondei}}
|}

===Spectral / rainbow system===
Rafsi based on the primary and secondary colors of the visible light spectrum.
{| class="wikitable"
! English !! Lojban
|-
| Sunday || {{jvs|xundei}}
|-
| Monday || {{jvs|najdei}}
|-
| Tuesday || {{jvs|peldei}}
|-
| Wednesday || {{jvs|ri'odje}} / '''ri'ordei'''
|-
| Thursday || {{jvs|cicnydei}}
|-
| Friday || {{jvs|bladei}}
|-
| Saturday || {{jvs|zirdei}}
|}

===Elemental system===
Rafsi based on historic alchemical/celestial associations, reflected in various languages (e.g. Japanese)

{| class="wikitable"
! English !! Lojban
|-
| Sunday || {{jvs|soldei}}
|-
| Monday || {{jvs|lurdei}}
|-
| Tuesday || {{jvs|fagdei}}
|-
| Wednesday || {{jvs|jaudje}} / '''jaurdei'''
|-
| Thursday || {{jvs|mudydei}}
|-
| Friday || {{jvs|jimdei}}
|-
| Saturday || {{jvs|derdei}}
|}
